title: Tennessee prison chief to resign after Christa Pike's failed execution, governor says
english: Tennessee's prison commissioner, Frank Strada, is resigning following a botched execution attempt of death row inmate Christa Pike. Pike survived two lethal injection procedures and is currently hospitalized in critical condition. Governor Bill Lee confirmed the resignation, as an official investigation into the failed execution process continues.
amharic: የቴነሲ ግዛት የእስር ቤቶች አስተዳደር ኮሚሽነር ፍራንክ ስትራዳ፣ ክሪስታ ፓይክ በተባለች እስረኛ ላይ የተፈጸመው የግድያ ሙከራ በመክሸፉ ምክንያት ስልጣናቸውን እንደሚለቁ አስታውቀዋል። ፓይክ ሁለት ጊዜ የተወጋችው ገዳይ መርፌ ሳይገድላት በመቅረቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በሆስፒታል በፅኑ ህክምና ላይ ትገኛለች። የክልሉ ገዢ ቢል ሊ የኮሚሽነሩን መልቀቅ ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ በጉዳዩ ላይ የተጀመረው ምርመራም ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Hogganaan mana sirreessaa kan mootummaa Tennessee, Frank Strada, yaaliin ajjeechaa hidhamaa Christa Pike irratti taasifame fashaluusaa hordofee aangoosaa gadhiisuuf murteesseera. Pike dugdaan du’aatti murtaa’ee kan ture yoo ta’u, saniifiin ajjeechaa ishee irratti fudhatame waan hin milkoofneef amma yaala yaalchiisaa jiru keessatti argamti. Bulchaan naannichaa Bill Lee gadi ba’uu hogganichaa kan mirkaneessan yoo ta’u, qorannoon sababa rakkoo kanaa adda baasuuf gaggeeffamu itti fufa.

title: What we know about the co-pilot accused in Flydubai attack
english: A Flydubai co-pilot, identified as Omani national Hamam al-Hammami, has been accused of carrying out a terrorist attack against the flight's captain. Reports indicate that al-Hammami had a history of being grounded by aviation authorities due to concerns regarding his extremist beliefs. The incident has raised serious questions about aviation security and personnel vetting protocols.
amharic: የፍላይዱባይ አብራሪ ረዳት የሆነው ኦማናዊው ሃማም አል-ሃማሚ፣ በአውሮፕላኑ ካፒቴን ላይ የሽብር ጥቃት ፈጽሟል ተብሎ ተከሷል። ግለሰቡ ቀደም ሲል በአክራሪ አመለካከቶች ምክንያት በበረራ እንዳይሳተፍ ተከልክሎ እንደነበር ተዘግቧል። ይህ ክስተት በአቪዬሽን ደህንነት እና በሰራተኞች ቅጥር ሂደት ላይ ከፍተኛ ጥያቄዎችን አስነስቷል።
oromo: Gargaaraan phaylootii xiyyara Flydubai lammii Omaan kan ta’e Hamam al-Hammami, kabiteenii xiyyarichaa irratti haleellaa shororkeessummaa raawwateera jedhamee himatameera. Gabaasoonni akka agarsiisanitti, al-Hammami yaada qarqaraa qabaachuu isaatiin walqabatee kanaan dura akka inni hin barrisne dhowwamee ture. Gochi kun nageenya xiyyarootaa fi qulqulleeffannaa hojjettootaa irratti gaaffii guddaa kaaseera.

title: ‘Bordering on angry’: The state of play as US midterms enter final month
english: As the US midterm elections enter their final month, Democrats are showing unexpected momentum in their bid to win control of the House of Representatives. President Donald Trump is facing record-low approval ratings as voters express deep frustration over economic issues and rising costs linked to the US-Israel conflict with Iran. In response, Republicans are shifting significant campaign funds to defend seats they previously considered safe.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ ወደ ፍጻሜው እየተቃረበ ባለበት በአሁኑ ወቅት፣ ዲሞክራቶች የአሜሪካን የተወካዮች ምክር ቤት ለመቆጣጠር ያላቸው ዕድል እየሰፋ መጥቷል። ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና በአሜሪካ-እስራኤል እና ኢራን ግጭት ሳቢያ በተፈጠረው የዋጋ ንረት የተበሳጩ መራጮች በመኖራቸው የድጋፍ መጠናቸው ወደ ታች ወርዷል። ሪፐብሊካኖችም ቀደም ሲል በቀላሉ ያሸንፋሉ ብለው የገመቷቸውን መቀመጫዎች ለማስጠበቅ ከፍተኛ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ እያደረጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Filannoon giddu galeessa US gara xumuraatti yeroo itti dhiyaate kanatti, paartiin Dimookraatootaa mana maree bakka buutotaa to’achuuf abdii guddaa argachaa jiru. Prezidaant Doolard Traamp rakkoo diinagdee fi gatii boba’aa dabaluun walqabatee rakkoo biyyattiin keessa jirtuun kan ka’e, deggarsi isaaniis sadarkaa gadi aanaa irra ga’eera. Paartiin Rippabilikaanii ammoo, bakka kanaan dura salphaatti mo’atu jedhame eegamaa ture of harkaa qabuuf mallaqa guddaa baasanii duula filannoo isaanii jabeeffachaa jiru.

title: At least 17 people, mostly pilgrims, killed in Kenya road crash
english: A tragic multi-vehicle collision in Kenya’s Salama region has resulted in the deaths of at least 17 people, primarily Catholic pilgrims traveling to a prayer site. The accident occurred when a truck attempted an unsafe overtake, leading to a crash with a minibus carrying the victims. Authorities have launched an investigation into the incident, which took place on a stretch of road frequently identified as a dangerous accident hotspot.
amharic: በኬንያ ሳላማ አካባቢ በተከሰተ አስከፊ የተሽከርካሪ ግጭት ቢያንስ 17 ሰዎች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ አብዛኞቹም ወደ ጸሎት ቦታ ሲጓዙ የነበሩ የካቶሊክ ምዕመናን ናቸው። አደጋው የደረሰው አንድ የጭነት መኪና አሽከርካሪ የሌላ ተሽከርካሪን ለመቅደም ሲሞክር ተቆጣጥሮት በመውደቁ ነው። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ላይ ምርመራ የጀመሩ ሲሆን፣ ቦታው በተደጋጋሚ አደጋዎች በሚከሰቱባቸው መንገዶች መካከል የሚጠቀስ መሆኑ ተገልጿል።
oromo: Keeniyaatti balaa konkolaataa hammaataa naannoo Salaamaatti mudateen namoonni 17 ol du'aniiru; isaan keessaa baay'een isaanii gara bakka kadhataatti imalaa kan turan amantoota Katoolikii turan. Balaan kun kan mudate erga konkolaataan fe'umsaa tokko karaa dogoggora ta'een konkolaataa biroo bira darbuuf yaalee booda konkolaataa namoota kana fe'e wajjin walitti bu'anii dha. Aangeyyoonni balaa kana irratti qorannoo eegalanii kan jiran yoo ta'u, iddoon kun bakka balaan konkolaataa itti heddummatu ta'uun isaa ibsameera.

title: What to know about Brazil’s 2026 presidential election
english: Brazil is preparing for a highly contested presidential election on October 4, featuring a close race between the incumbent Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and his right-wing opponent, Flavio Bolsonaro. The political climate remains tense following the imprisonment of former leader Jair Bolsonaro for his involvement in a failed coup plot. Voters are primarily focused on the nation's economic struggles and rising crime rates as the country navigates this pivotal moment in its democracy.
amharic: ብራዚል በጥቅምት 4 ቀን በሚካሄደው የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ፣ አሁን በስልጣን ላይ ያሉት ሉዊዝ ኢናሲዮ ሉላ ዳ ሲልቫ እና የቀኝ ዘመም ተቃዋሚው ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ መካከል ከፍተኛ ፉክክር እየተጠበቀ ነው። የቀድሞው መሪ ጃኢር ቦልሶናሮ መፈንቅለ መንግስት ለመሞከር በመታሰራቸው የሀገሪቱ የፖለቲካ ሁኔታ ውጥረት ውስጥ ይገኛል። መራጮች በተለይም በሀገሪቱ እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና የወንጀል ስጋቶች በዋናነት እየተመለከቱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Brazil qophii filannoo pirezidaantummaa kan Onkoloolessa 4 gaggeeffamuuf jiru keessa jirti; filannichis giddu galeessa pirezidaantii ammaa Luwiiz Inaasiyoo Luulaa daa Siilvaa fi mormituu mirgaa Flaaviwoo Bolsoonaaroo gidduutti wal dorgommii cimaan akka jiraatu dubbatamaa jira. Hogganaan duraanii Jaayir Bolsoonaaroo yaalii fonqolcha mootummaan hidhamuun isaanii haala siyaasaa biyyattii keessatti dhiibbaa uumee jira. Lammiileen biyyattii rakkoo dinagdee fi dabalata yakkaatiif xiyyeeffannoo guddaa kennuun filannicha hordofaa jiru.

title: Report: Israeli attempt to kill senior Hamas official fails
english: The Israeli military recently carried out an unsuccessful operation aimed at killing Ali al-Amoudi, a high-ranking Hamas official in Gaza. Reports indicate that al-Amoudi has been acting as the primary leader in the region, effectively filling the role previously held by Yahya Sinwar. Despite the effort, the targeted individual managed to survive the attack.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጦር በጋዛ የሚገኘውን ከፍተኛ የሀማስ ባለስልጣን አሊ አል-አሙዲን ለመግደል ያደረገው ሙከራ ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል። እንደ ዘገባዎቹ ከሆነ፣ አል-አሙዲ ቀደም ሲል በያህያ ሲንዋር ይያዝ የነበረውን ስልጣን በመረከብ በጋዛ የቡድኑን ዋና መሪ ሆነው እያገለገሉ ይገኛሉ። ምንም እንኳን ጥቃቱ ቢሰነዘርም ግለሰቡ በህይወት ተርፈዋል።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el hogganaa olaanaa garee Hamaas kan Gaazaatti argamu Alii al-Amuudii ajjeesuuf yaaliin inni godhe milkaa'uu hin dandeenye. Gabaasni akka ibsutti, Amuudiin gahee Yahiyaa Sinwaar duraan qabachaa turan guutuun, ammaan tana hogganaa olaanaa ta'anii hojjachaa jiru. Yaalii ajjeechaa kana keessatti garuu, namichi kun lubbuun ooluu danda'eera.

title: Eight Palestinians, including mother and daughter, killed in attacks across Gaza since dawn
english: At least eight Palestinians have lost their lives in ongoing Israeli attacks across Gaza since this morning. Among the casualties was a mother and her daughter, who were killed when an apartment building was destroyed in Gaza City. Other victims included individuals who died from injuries sustained during previous strikes.
amharic: ከዛሬ ማለዳ ጀምሮ በተለያዩ የጋዛ አካባቢዎች በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት ቢያንስ ስምንት ፍልስጤማውያን ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በጋዛ ከተማ አንድ የመኖሪያ ሕንፃ ሲመታ እናትና ሴት ልጇን ጨምሮ በርካታ ሰዎች ተገድለዋል። ሌሎች ተጎጂዎች ደግሞ ቀደም ብለው በደረሱባቸው ጉዳቶች ምክንያት ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሰዎች ናቸው።
oromo: Ganama har'aa irraa jalqabee weerara Israa'el ganda Gaaza keessatti gaggeessiteen palastinaanonni saddeet ol ta'an lubbuun darbaniiru. Magaala Gaaza keessatti mana jireenyaa tokko irratti haleellaa raawwatameen haadha fi intalli ishee lubbuun kan darban yoo ta'u, namoonni biroos madaa duraan irra gaheen du'aniiru.

title: Israeli attack injures several Palestinians in Gaza
english: Several Palestinians were wounded in a drone strike carried out by Israeli forces in Gaza City on Friday evening. The attack took place near a local school, resulting in multiple casualties including some individuals in critical condition. Victims were promptly transported to a nearby medical facility for urgent treatment.
amharic: አርብ ምሽት በጋዛ ከተማ በእስራኤል ድሮን በተፈጸመ ጥቃት በርካታ ፍልስጤማውያን ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው በአንድ ትምህርት ቤት አቅራቢያ ሲሆን፣ ጉዳት ከደረሰባቸው መካከልም አንዳንዶቹ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው ተገልጿል። የተጎዱት ሰዎች በአስቸኳይ ወደ ህክምና ተቋማት ተወስደው ህክምና እየተደረገላቸው ይገኛል።
oromo: Dilbata darbe magaalaa Gaazaatti haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin feene (drone) Israa'el raawwattee kanaan namoonni biyyoolessaa Filisxeem hedduun madaa'aniiru. Haleellaan kun mana barnootaa tokko biratti kan raawwatame yoo ta'u, miidhaa cimaa irra ga'een lubbuun namoota tokko tokkoo balaa keessa galeera. Namoonni miidhaman kun yeroo ammaa hospitaala galanii yaalamaa jiru.

title: Yemeni army claims 1,540 Houthi casualties as fighting intensifies in Taiz
english: The Yemeni military reported that over 1,500 Houthi fighters were killed or injured following intense clashes over the last 24 hours, primarily in the Taiz region. Government forces launched nearly 500 targeted attacks using aircraft, drones, and heavy artillery to strike rebel command centers and military assets. This surge in fighting marks a significant escalation in the ongoing conflict as government troops push to reclaim various parts of the province.
amharic: የየመን መንግሥት ጦር ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ በተካሄደው ከፍተኛ ውጊያ ከ1,500 በላይ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መገደላቸውንና መቁሰላቸውን አስታውቋል። የመንግሥት ጦር በአውሮፕላኖች፣ በድሮኖች እና በከባድ መሳሪያዎች በመታገዝ በታኢዝ ግዛት በሚገኙ የሁቲዎች ዋና መቆጣጠሪያ ማዕከላትና ወታደራዊ ካምፖች ላይ ከ470 በላይ ጥቃቶችን ፈጽሟል። ይህ የአካባቢው ግጭት እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን የሚያሳይ ሲሆን የመንግሥት ኃይሎችም በተለያዩ የጠቅላይ ግዛቷ አካባቢዎች እንቅስቃሴያቸውን አጠናክረዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Yemen akka beeksisetti, sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti waraana naannoo Ta'izitti geggeeffameen loltoonni Huutii 1,540 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu ykn madaa'uu ibseera. Waraanni mootummaa xiyyaarota, diroonotaa fi meeshaalee waraanaa gurguddaa fayyadamuun bakkeewwan Huutiin itti guddatan irratti duula 474 ol gaggeesseera. Waraanni kun daangaa biyyattii keessatti waldhabdee uumame hammaachuu isaa kan agarsiisu yoo ta'u, loltoonni mootummaa naannoo sana guututti to'annaa isaanii jala galchuuf carraaqqii cimaa gochaa jiru.

title: Palestinian man succumbs to wounds sustained from Israeli attack in Deir el-Balah
english: A Palestinian man named Mohammad Talat Aqel has passed away following a head injury caused by Israeli gunfire. He had been receiving medical care at Al-Aqsa Hospital in Deir el-Balah for several days before succumbing to his wounds. The incident occurred in the Umm Dhuhair area located in central Gaza.
amharic: ሞሃመድ ታላት አቀል የተባሉ ፍልስጤማዊ በዴይር ኤል-ባላህ በተፈጸመ የእስራኤል ጥቃት በደረሰባቸው የጭንቅላት ጉዳት ህይወታቸው አልፏል። ለበርካታ ቀናት በአል-አቅሳ ሆስፒታል ህክምና ሲደረግላቸው የቆዩ ቢሆንም በደረሰባቸው ከባድ ጉዳት ምክንያት ህይወታቸው ሊተርፍ አልቻለም። ይህ አሳዛኝ ክስተት የተከሰተው በጋዛ ማዕከላዊ ክፍል በኡም ዱሃይር አካባቢ ነው።
oromo: Namni Falasxiinii Mohammad Talat Aqel jedhamu, haleellaa waraana Israa'el naannoo Deir el-Balahitti isarratti raawwatameen mataasaatti miidhaa cimaa irra ga'ee ture. Guyyoota muraasaaf Hospitaala Al-Aqsa keessatti yaalamaa kan ture yoo ta'u, miidhicha dandamachuu dadhabee lubbuun isaa darbeera. Haleellaan kun kan raawwatame naannoo Umm Dhuhair, giddugaleessa Gaazaa keessatti.

title: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with axe, UAE official says
english: A Flydubai co-pilot attacked the captain with a cockpit axe while the plane was flying from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The aircraft dropped 17,000 feet before passengers and crew managed to subdue the attacker and land the plane safely in Saudi Arabia. UAE authorities are currently investigating the incident to determine if the motive was linked to terrorism or radicalization.
amharic: አንድ የፍላይዱባይ ረዳት አብራሪ ከዱባይ ወደ ቴል አቪቭ በመብረር ላይ በነበረ አውሮፕላን ውስጥ ካፒቴኑን በመጥረቢያ አጥቅቷል። አውሮፕላኑ 17,000 ጫማ ወደ ታች ከተንሸራተተ በኋላ ተሳፋሪዎች እና የበረራ ሰራተኞች አጥቂውን በመቆጣጠር አውሮፕላኑን በሳውዲ አረቢያ በሰላም ማሳረፍ ችለዋል። የተባበሩት አረብ ኢምሬትስ ባለስልጣናት ድርጊቱ ከሽብርተኝነት ወይም ከጽንፈኝነት ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Gargaaraan balaliisaa xiyyaara Flydubai tokko imala Dubai irraa gara Tel Aviv adeemaa ture keessatti kabitanii isaa qottoon haleelee jira. Xiyyaarichi miila 17,000 gadi bu'ee erga raafamee booda, imaltoonni fi hojjettoonni xiyyaarichaa haleelticha to'annoo jala oolchanii xiyyaaricha biyya Sa'ud Arabiyaatti nagaan buusuu danda'aniiru. Bulchiinsi biyya UAE qorannoo jalqabeen gochi kun shororkeessummaa ykn yaada qaxaleessummaa wajjin walqabatuu isaa adda baasuuf yaalii gochaa jira.

title: Protesters across Spain demand action over housing crisis
english: Thousands of people across Spain are protesting to demand better housing protections after the government failed to pass emergency legislation. The unrest was sparked by the eviction of an elderly woman, leading to widespread calls for lower rents and stricter rules on property investments. This legislative defeat has weakened Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez’s government and created uncertainty about the potential for early national elections.
amharic: በስፔን መንግስት ድንገተኛ የመኖሪያ ቤት ህግን ማሳለፍ ባለመቻሉ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ዜጎች የተሻለ የቤት ተከራይ መብቶችን በመጠየቅ ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ ወጥተዋል። የአንድ አረጋዊት ሴት ከቤት መፈናቀል ያስከተለው ቁጣ ህዝቡ የቤት ኪራይ እንዲቀንስ እና በሪል እስቴት ኢንቨስትመንቶች ላይ ቁጥጥር እንዲደረግ እንዲጠይቅ አድርጎታል። ይህ የፓርላማ ሽንፈት የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝን መንግስት የጎዳ ሲሆን፣ ቀደም ብሎ ምርጫ ሊደረግ ይችላል የሚል ስጋትም ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Mootummaan ispain seera ariifachiisaa mana jireenyaa dabarsuu dadhabuu isaa hordofee, namoonni kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman mirga gurguddaa qabaachuu gaafachuun hiriira bahaniiru. Ari'iinsi dubartii manguddoo tokkoo aariin uummataa akka dabalu taasisun, kireen manaa akka hir'atu fi invastimantiin lafaa fi mana jireenyaa irratti seerri cimaan akka ba'u gaafataniiru. Injifatannoon paarlaamaa kun mootummaa muummicha ministeeraa Pedro Sanchez irratti dhiibbaa uumuun, filannoon biyyoolessaa yeroodhaan dursee geggeeffamuu danda'a jedhamee sodaatama jira.

title: World No 1 Sinner withdraws from Shanghai Masters as knee injury lingers
english: World number one tennis player Jannik Sinner has withdrawn from the upcoming Shanghai Masters due to an ongoing knee injury. The Italian athlete has been unable to compete since his victory at Wimbledon in July, forcing him to miss several major tournaments including the US Open. His absence in Shanghai provides an opportunity for Alexander Zverev to challenge for the top world ranking.
amharic: የዓለም የቴኒስ ደረጃ አንደኛ የሆነው ጃኒክ ሲነር በጉልበት ጉዳት ምክንያት በመጪው የሻንጋይ ማስተርስ ውድድር ላይ እንደማይሳተፍ አስታውቋል። ጣሊያናዊው ተጫዋች ከሐምሌ ወር የዊምብልደን ድሉ ወዲህ ባጋጠመው ጉዳት ምክንያት የዩኤስ ኦፕንን ጨምሮ በርካታ ውድድሮችን አምልጦታል። የእሱ መቅረት ለዓለም ደረጃ አንደኛነት እየተፎካከረ ለሚገኘው አሌክሳንደር ዝቬሬቭ ጥሩ አጋጣሚን ይፈጥራል።
oromo: Taphataan tenisiin addunyaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa irratti argamu Jannik Sinner, miidhama jilbaa isaa kanaan wal-qabatee dorgommii Shanghai Masters dhufu irratti akka hin hirmaanne beeksiseera. Atileetichi lammii Xaaliyaanii kun injifannoo Wiimbaldan Caamsaa darbe booda miidhamuu isaatiin wal-qabatee, dorgommiwwan gurguddoo hedduu dabalatee US Open irraa hafeera. Hin hirmaannaan isaa kun, atileetii Alexander Zverev jedhamuuf sadarkaa addunyaa tokkoffaa qabachuuf carraa guddaa banaafii jira.

title: The double standards of a failed execution
english: The U.S. state of Tennessee recently failed to execute Christa Pike, a 50-year-old woman with a history of severe trauma and mental illness, after a botched lethal injection attempt. The author argues that this situation highlights a global double standard, as similar human rights failures in countries like Iran would face widespread international condemnation. Pike, who committed her crime as a teenager, survived the attempt and is now suffering from its physical effects, reigniting concerns about the cruelty and ethics of the death penalty.
amharic: የአሜሪካዋ ቴነሲ ግዛት በቅርቡ ክሪስታ ፓይክ የተባለች የአእምሮ ህመም እና የልጅነት አሰቃቂ ታሪክ ያላት ሴት ላይ የሞት ፍርድ ለመፈጸም ያደረገችው ሙከራ ሳይሳካ ቀርቷል። ደራሲው እንደሚሉት፣ ይህ ክስተት በአለም አቀፍ ደረጃ ያለውን አድሎአዊ አመለካከት የሚያሳይ ነው፤ ምክንያቱም ተመሳሳይ ሁኔታ በኢራን ቢከሰት ኖሮ ከፍተኛ አለም አቀፍ ተቃውሞ ይነሳ ነበር። በጉርምስና ዕድሜዋ በፈጸመችው ወንጀል የተፈረደባት ፓይክ፣ በከሸፈው የሞት ፍርድ ሙከራ ምክንያት ጉዳት የደረሰባት ሲሆን፣ ይህም የሞት ፍርድ አሰጣጥ ላይ ያለውን ኢሰብአዊነት አከራካሪ አድርጎታል።
oromo: Mootummaan naannoo Tennessee kan Ameerikaa, dubartii waggaa 50 kan taate Christa Pike irratti adabbii du'aa raawwachuuf yaalii gooteen kan hin milkoofne yoo ta'u, kunis rakkoo sammuu fi miidhaa darbee kan qabdu turte. Barreessaan kun akka jedhutti, gochi kun garaagarummaa qajeelfamaa kan agarsiisuudha; sababiin isaas gosti yakka akkasii biyyoota akka Iraan keessatti yoo ta'e dubbiin kun balaaleffannaa addunyaa ni hordofata ture. Pike yakka isheen yeroo dargaggummaatti raawwatteef adabbiin kun kan irratti murteeffame yoo ta'u, yaaliin ajjeechaa sun fashaluun isaa miidhaa qaamaa ishee irraan ga'ee fi mormii waa'ee adabbii du'aa irratti har'a ka'ee jiruuf sababa ta'eera.

title: Ethiopia’s government forces retake airport from Tigray rebels in Mekelle
english: Ethiopian government forces have regained control of the Alula Aba Nega Airport in Mekelle, following a recent retreat by Tigrayan rebel fighters. Local reports indicate that the rebels are leaving the city, raising concerns among residents about a potential security vacuum and looting. The federal military is currently conducting a counteroffensive to reclaim territories that were seized by a coalition of rebel groups last month.

oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Itoophiyaa buufata xiyyaaraa Alula Aba Nagaa kan magaalaa Maqalee toannoo isaanii jala deebisanii oolchaniiru. Waraanni Tigraay magaalaa sana gadi dhiisanii bahuun kan gabaasame yoo ta'u, jiraattonni magaalaatti dhabamuun nageenyaa fi saamichi akka mudatu sodaachaa jiru. Waraanni federaalaa ji'a darbe gareewwan finxaaleyyiin qabaman deebisanii qabachuuf duula geggeessaa jiru.

title: Palestinians gather for football amid Gaza’s ruins
english: Displaced Palestinians in Khan Younis recently organized a friendly football match to find a brief moment of normalcy amidst the ongoing conflict. They played the game on a makeshift field surrounded by destroyed buildings and tents housing those uprooted by the war. This event highlights the resilience of the local community as they attempt to maintain daily life despite the constant threat of Israeli military operations.
amharic: በካን ዩኒስ የሚገኙ የተፈናቀሉ ፍልስጤማውያን በጦርነቱ መካከል ትንሽ እፎይታ ለማግኘት የወዳጅነት እግር ኳስ ጨዋታ አዘጋጅተዋል። ጨዋታውን ያካሄዱት በአካባቢው በሚገኙ የድንኳን መጠለያዎች እና የፈራረሱ ሕንፃዎች መካከል በተዘጋጀ ሜዳ ላይ ነው። ይህ ኩነት የፍልስጤም ህዝቦች በየቀኑ ከሚደርስባቸው የጦርነት ስጋት ጋር እንኳን መደበኛ ህይወታቸውን ለመቀጠል የሚያደርጉትን ጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Namoonni Falasxiin biyyoota isaanii irraa buqqa'anii fi magaalaa Khan Yunis keessa jiraatan, waldhabdee fi waraana jiru gidduutti tasgabbii argachuuf tapha kubbaa miilaa michummaa gaggeessaniiru. Tapha kana kan taphatan naannoo buufata dunkaanaatii fi manni diigaman jiranitti dirree salphaa tokko qopheessuudhaan. Taphni kun ummanni Falasxiin miidhaa waraanaa fi soda jiru hundumaa caalaa jireenya isaanii itti fufsiisuuf carraaqqii gochaa jiran kan agarsiisu dha.

title: How AI is helping Mexico detect breast cancer earlier
english: Mexico is utilizing artificial intelligence to address the shortage of medical specialists and reduce lengthy wait times for breast cancer screenings. The technology works by identifying potentially dangerous scans, which are then analyzed by doctors who work from remote locations. This initiative aims to improve early detection rates for patients across the country.
amharic: ሜክሲኮ የጡት ካንሰር ምርመራን ለማፋጠን እና የባለሙያዎችን እጥረት ለመቅረፍ አርቲፊሻል ኢንተለጀንስ ቴክኖሎጂን እየተጠቀመች ነው። ይህ ቴክኖሎጂ አጠራጣሪ የሆኑ የምርመራ ውጤቶችን ለይቶ በማውጣት በሩቅ ቦታ ለሚገኙ ባለሙያዎች በመላክ እንዲታዩ ያደርጋል። ይህ ዘዴ ካንሰርን በቶሎ በመለየት የታካሚዎችን የጤና ውጤት ለማሻሻል ትልቅ ሚና ይጫወታል።
oromo: Meksiikoon hanqina ogeeyyii fayyaa fi yeroo dheeraa fudhatu hambisuuf teeknoolojii 'artifiishal intelejensii' fayyadamuun qorannoo kaansarii harmaa saffisiisuuf hojjechaa jirti. Teeknoolojiin kun fakkiiwwan qorannoo shakki qaban adda baasuun ogeeyyii fagoo jiran biratti erguun akka ilaalamu taasisa. Tarsiimoon kun dhukkubicha dursee adda baasuun lubbuu namaa baraaruuf gargaara.

title: 'The entire land is ours': Ben Gvir escalates calls for annexation of occupied West Bank
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has publicly declared that the entire West Bank belongs to Israel. He stated that if he becomes defense minister, he intends to dissolve the Palestinian Authority and encourage the displacement of Palestinians from the region. These remarks challenge the existing Oslo Accords, which designate specific territories for Palestinian governance.
amharic: የእስራኤል የብሔራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር ሙሉው የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት የእስራኤል ነው ሲሉ ተናገሩ። የሀገር መከላከያ ሚኒስትር ቢሆኑ የፍልስጤም አስተዳደርን እንደሚያፈርሱ እና ፍልስጤማውያን ከቀዬአቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ እንደሚሰሩ አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ንግግራቸው በፍልስጤም አስተዳደር ስልጣን ስር ያሉ ቦታዎችን በሚመለከት ቀደም ሲል የነበሩ የኦስሎ ስምምነቶችን የሚቃወም ነው።
oromo: Ministeerri Nageenya Biyyaalessaa Israa'el Itaamar Ben Gviir, guutummaan naannoo West Baank kan Israa'el akka ta'e dubbatan. Yoo ministeera ittisa biyyaa ta'an, bulchiinsa Paalastayinii diiguufi uummata Paalastayinii naannichaa buqqisuuf akka hojjatan himaniiru. Yaadni kun waliigaltee seena qabeessa kan Oslo kan naannolee Paalastayinii beekamtii kenne mormuudha.

title: Gaza death toll rises after seven Palestinians killed in 24 hours
english: The Gaza health ministry reports that seven more Palestinians have been killed by Israeli strikes over the past day, bringing the total death toll to 74,229. Recent casualties include people rescued from rubble and those who died from earlier injuries. Additionally, thousands recently attended a mass funeral for over 100 victims whose bodies were recovered from a building destroyed early in the conflict.
amharic: የጋዛ ጤና ጥበቃ ሚኒስቴር እንዳስታወቀው ባለፉት ሃያ አራት ሰዓታት ውስጥ በእስራኤል ጥቃት ሰባት ፍልስጤማውያን በመገደላቸው አጠቃላይ የሟቾች ቁጥር 74,229 ደርሷል። የቅርብ ጊዜዎቹ ሰለባዎች በፍርስራሽ ውስጥ የተገኙትን እና ቀደም ሲል በደረሰባቸው ጉዳት ህይወታቸው ያለፈ ሰዎችን ያጠቃልላል። በተጨማሪም በቅርቡ ከጥቃቱ መጀመሪያ አንስቶ በፍርስራሽ ስር ተቀብረው የነበሩ ከ100 በላይ ለሚሆኑ የሟቾች አስከሬን የቀብር ስነ-ስርዓት ተፈጽሟል።
oromo: Ministeerri fayyaa Gaaza akka ibsetti, guyyoota darban keessa haleellaa Israa'el raawwateen Paalastayinoonni torba ajjeefamanii, lakkoofsi namoota du'anii walii galaa 74,229 gahee jira. Namoota guyyoota darban keessa du'an keessaa muraasni isaanii diigamuu manaa jala kan baafaman yoo ta'u, kaan immoo madaa kanaan dura irra gaheen kan du'anidha. Kana malees, lammiileen kumaatamaan lakkaawwaman namoota 100 ol ta'an kanneen haleellaa waggaa darbe keessa bakka diigame keessatti hafan turanif sirna awwaalchaa gaggeessaniiru.

title: Reports of 'massive, successive and powerful' explosions in southern Lebanese town
english: Multiple strong explosions were reported in the southern Lebanese town of Mansouri. According to local media, these powerful blasts were carried out by Israeli forces. The incident highlights ongoing military tensions in the region.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ሊባኖስ ማንሱሪ በተባለች ከተማ ውስጥ ተከታታይ እና ከፍተኛ ፍንዳታዎች መከሰታቸው ተዘግቧል። የሊባኖስ መገናኛ ብዙኃን እንደዘገቡት እነዚህ ኃይለኛ ፍንዳታዎች በእስራኤል ኃይሎች የተፈጸሙ ናቸው። ይህ ክስተት በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Magaalota kibba Libanon keessaa ishee Mansuurii jedhamtu keessatti dhohiinsi cimaan akkasumas walitti aansuun dhaga'ameera. Gabaasota miidiyaa biyyaattii akka ibsanitti, dhohiinsi kun humnoota Israa'elidhaan kan raawwatame dha. Gochi kunis naannichatti waraana fi wal-dhabiinsi jiru akka itti fufe agarsiisa.

title: Watch: Ben-Gvir says Israel would sell Palestinians to other countries
english: Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir has suggested that Israel should pay other nations to accept Palestinian people as a way to remove them from the region. During a recent television interview, he proposed using financial incentives to facilitate this relocation. His comments have sparked significant controversy regarding his stance on the Palestinian population.
amharic: የእስራኤሉ ቀኝ ዘመም ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን-ግቪር፣ ፍልስጤማውያንን ከክልሉ ለማስወጣት ሌሎች ሀገራት እንዲቀበሏቸው ለእነዚያ ሀገራት ክፍያ መፈጸም እንዳለበት ሃሳብ አቅርበዋል። በአንድ የቴሌቪዥን ቃለ-መጠይቅ ላይ እንደተናገሩት፣ ይህን የፍልስጤማውያን መፈናቀል ለማፋጠን የገንዘብ ማበረታቻ መጠቀም እንደሚቻል ጠቁመዋል። ይህ አወዛጋቢ አስተያየታቸው በአካባቢው ከፍተኛ ትችት አስነስቷል።
oromo: Ministeerri Israa'el Itamar Ben-Gviir, lammiilee Falasxiin naannichaa irraa gadi baasuuf biyyoonni biroo akka isaan simatanuf maallaqa kaffaluun akka barbaachisu yaada kennaniiru. Gaaffii fi deebii televijiinii irratti, haala kana salphisuuf badhaasa maallaqaa fayyadamuun akka danda'amu dubbataniiru. Yaanni kunis Falasxiinotaa irratti qaban irratti mormii cimaa kaaseera.

title: 'The entire land is ours': Ben Gvir escalates calls for annexation of occupied West Bank
english: Israeli National Security Minister Itamar Ben Gvir has publicly declared his intent to annex the entire West Bank and dismantle the Palestinian Authority if he becomes defense minister. He is advocating for policies that would encourage the displacement of Palestinians and provide soldiers with greater authority to use force. These remarks, made ahead of the upcoming Knesset elections, highlight his extreme political stance regarding Palestinian territories.
amharic: የእስራኤል ብሄራዊ ደህንነት ሚኒስትር ኢታማር ቤን ግቪር የመከላከያ ሚኒስትር ከሆኑ ሙሉውን የዌስት ባንክ ግዛት ለመቀላቀል እና የፍልስጤም አስተዳደርን ለማፍረስ እቅድ እንዳላቸው በይፋ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ፍልስጤማውያን ከቀያቸው እንዲለቁ የሚያበረታቱ ፖሊሲዎችን ለመተግበር እና ወታደሮች የኃይል እርምጃ እንዲወስዱ ያላቸውን ነፃነት ለማስፋት ጠይቀዋል። እነዚህ ንግግሮች የተሰሙት በአስራኤል የፓርላማ ምርጫ ዋዜማ ሲሆን የአቋማቸውን አክራሪነት ያሳያል።
oromo: Ministeerri Nageenya Biyyaalessaa Israa'el Itaamaar Ben Gvir, yoo ministeera ittisa biyyaa ta'an guutummaa daangaa Weest Baank qabachuufi qaama bulchiinsa Falasxeem diiguuf karoora akka qaban ifatti dubbataniiru. Kana malees, Falasxeemonni lafa isaanii akka gadi lisan jajjabeessuufi loltoonni humna waraanaa akka fayyadaman mirga bal'aa akka argatan gaafataniiru. Yaanni kun kan ibsame filannoo Israa'el dhihaatu ilaalchisee yoo ta'u, ejjennoo siyaasaa isaan cimaa ta'e agarsiisa.

title: Russia strikes second major bridge in Kyiv, mayor says
english: Russian forces have struck a second major bridge in Kyiv, causing damage to the road and power infrastructure. Mayor Vitali Klitschko noted that these attacks on critical transit routes between the eastern and western parts of the city signal an escalation in Moscow's strategy. Emergency crews are currently managing the situation, which has led to significant traffic disruptions and heightened security concerns across the capital.
amharic: የሩሲያ ኃይሎች በኪየቭ ከተማ ሁለተኛውን ትልቅ ድልድይ በመምታት በመንገድ እና በኤሌክትሪክ መሠረተ ልማት ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። የከተማዋ ከንቲባ ቪታሊ ክሊችኮ እንዳሉት እነዚህ በከተማዋ ምስራቃዊ እና ምዕራባዊ ክፍሎች መካከል ባሉ ወሳኝ መተላለፊያዎች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ ጥቃቶች የሞስኮ የጦርነት ስትራቴጂ እየተባባሰ መምጣቱን ያሳያል። የአስቸኳይ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በስፍራው ተገኝተው ጉዳቱን ለማስተካከል እየሰሩ ሲሆን፣ ጥቃቱ በትራፊክ እንቅስቃሴ ላይ ከፍተኛ መስተጓጎል እና የጸጥታ ስጋት ፈጥሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni Raashiyaa gamoo riqicha guddaa lammaffaa magaalaa Kiyiv keessatti argamu haleeluun miidhaa karaa fi bu’uuraaleealee misoomaa irratti geessisaniiru. Kantiibaan magaalattii Vitali Klichko akka ibsanitti, riqichota kana haleeluu jechuun tarsiimoon waraanaa Moskoo daran hammaataa dhufuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha. Gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa haala sana to’achuuf hojjechaa jiran yoo ta’u, haleellaan kun imala konkolaataa fi nageenya magaalattii irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumeera.

title: Singer Zach Bryan wears Free Palestine shirt at Gillette Stadium
english: Country music artist Zach Bryan recently wore a t-shirt supporting Palestine during his concert at Gillette Stadium. This stadium is owned by Robert Kraft, a billionaire known for his strong support of Israel. The incident is notable because Kraft previously blocked another musician, Macklemore, from performing at the venue due to his pro-Palestine views.
amharic: የሀገር ሙዚቃ ዘፋኙ ዛክ ብራያን በጊሌት ስታዲየም ባደረገው ኮንሰርት ላይ ፍልስጤምን የሚደግፍ ቲሸርት ለብሶ ታይቷል። ይህ ስታዲየም የእስራኤል ደጋፊ በሆኑት ቢሊየነር ሮበርት ክራፍት ባለቤትነት ስር ያለ ነው። ክራፍት ከዚህ ቀደም ፍልስጤምን የሚደግፍ አቋም የነበረውን ዘፋኝ ማክለሞር በስታዲየማቸው እንዳይዘፍን መከልከላቸው ይታወሳል።
oromo: Artistii muuziqaa biyyaalessaa kan ta'e Zaak Biraayaan, oobdii Jileet Steediyeem keessatti sirba isaa irratti uffata Falaastiiniif deeggarsa agarsiisu uffatee ture. Steediyeemni kun kan qabamee fi to'atamu biiliyooneera Roobart Kiraafti kan Israa'eliif deeggarsa guddaa qabuun dha. Kiraafti kanaan dura muuziqeessaa biroo Maaklemoor jedhamu yaada isaa kan Falaastiinii deeggaru waan ibseef, akka achitti hin sirbine dhorkachuun isaa ni yaadatama.

title: ‘Trauma still there’: A decades-old standoff returns to Northern Ireland
english: Tensions have resurfaced in Portadown, Northern Ireland, as long-standing disputes over traditional Orange Order marches return to the Garvaghy Road. Residents still carry the heavy trauma from the 1990s, when conflicts between marchers and the local community often turned violent. The memory of the 1999 assassination of lawyer Rosemary Nelson, who advocated for the residents, remains a painful reminder of the region's unfinished history.
amharic: በሰሜን አየርላንድ ፖርታዳውን ከተማ፣ የኦሬንጅ ኦርደር ሰልፎች በሚያደርጉት የተቃውሞ እንቅስቃሴ ምክንያት የቆየ የጥላቻ ትዝታ እንደገና አገረሸ። ነዋሪዎቹ በ1990ዎቹ ውስጥ በሰልፈኞችና በአካባቢው ማህበረሰብ መካከል ተፈጥሮ የነበረውን ግጭት እና በወቅቱ የተፈጠረውን ከፍተኛ ቀውስ አሁንም በህመም ያስታውሳሉ። የነዋሪዎቹን መብት በመከራከር ትታወቅ የነበረችው ጠበቃ ሮዝመሪ ኔልሰን በ1999 መገደሏ፣ የክልሉን የፈውስ ሂደት አሁንም ያልተቋጨ መሆኑን የሚያሳይ ህመም ነው።
oromo: Magaalaa Portadawn kan Kaaba Aayerlaandi, walitti bu’iinsi durii duula 'Orange Order' jedhamuun walqabatee ture deebi’ee ka’eera. Jiraattoonni naannichaa yeroo ammaa kana yaada gadadoo fi miidhaa bara 1990 keessa turesi irraa argatan keessatti argamu. Akkaataan ajjeechaa abukaattoo Rosemary Nelson bara 1999 raawwatamee fi isheen namoota naannichaaf falmitu turte, seenaan naannichaa kan hin guutaminneefi miidhaan isaa ammallee akka jirutti akka jiru yaadachiisa.

title: India vs Pakistan live: Asian Games cricket final
english: In the men's cricket final at the Asian Games, India set a target of 212 runs for Pakistan to win the gold medal. Strong batting performances from Abhishek Sharma and Tilak Varma helped India reach a total of 211 runs for the loss of six wickets. Pakistan now needs to score 212 runs within their 20 overs to claim the championship title.
amharic: በእስያ ጨዋታዎች የወንዶች ክሪኬት ፍጻሜ ህንድ ለፓኪስታን የ212 ሩጫ ኢላማ በመጣል የወርቅ ሜዳሊያውን ለማሸነፍ ተፋልመዋል። በሁለቱ ተጫዋቾች በአቢሼክ ሻርማ እና ቲላክ ቫርማ ጥሩ ብቃት ህንድ በ20 ኦቨር 211 ሩጫዎችን ማስመዝገብ ችላለች። አሁን ፓኪስታን የወርቅ ሜዳሊያውን ለመውሰድ በተመደበው ጊዜ ውስጥ 212 ሩጫዎችን ማስቆጠር ይጠበቅባታል።
oromo: Tapha xumuraa kriketii dhiirota tapha Aasiyaa irratti, Hindii injifannoo argachuuf Paakistaaniif galii 212 saaxilteetti. Taphattoota Hindii kanneen akka Abishek Sharma fi Tilak Varma qabxii gaarii galchuun, Hindii ooverii 20 keessatti galii 211 galchuun injifannoo guddaa argatteetti. Amma Paakistaan medaalii warqee fudhachuuf ooverii 20 keessatti galii 212 galchuun ishee irraa eegama.

title: Flydubai co-pilot stabbed captain with crash axe in ‘terrorist’ attack: UAE
english: A Flydubai co-pilot is being investigated for a terrorist act after attacking the captain with an emergency axe during a flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv. The suspect attempted to seize control of the aircraft, causing it to drop significantly in altitude before other crew members regained stability. The flight, carrying 174 passengers, successfully conducted an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia, and authorities are currently probing the motive behind the assault.
amharic: የፍላይዱባይ ረዳት አብራሪ ከዱባይ ወደ ተል አቪቭ በረራ ላይ እያለ ዋናውን አብራሪ በአደጋ ጊዜ መቆራረጫ መጥረቢያ በማጥቃት የሽብር ድርጊት ፈጽሟል ተብሎ እየተመረመረ ይገኛል። ጥቃት አድራሹ አውሮፕላኑን ለመቆጣጠር በመሞከሩ አውሮፕላኑ ከፍተኛ ቁመት እንዲያጣ አድርጓል፤ ሆኖም ሌሎች የበረራ ሰራተኞች አውሮፕላኑን መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። 174 ተሳፋሪዎችን የያዘው አውሮፕላን በሳውዲ አረቢያ አስቸኳይ ማረፊያ ያደረገ ሲሆን፣ የህግ አካላትም የተፈጠረውን ክስተት ተነሳሽነት ለማወቅ ምርመራ እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Gargaaraan balaliisaa xiyyaara Flydubai tokko balalii Dubaayii gara Tel Aviv imala irra jirutti, kabajaan xiyyaarichaa kottee lubbuu oolchuun miidhuun yakka shororkeessummaa raawwachuu isaan qorannoon irratti gaggeeffamaa jira. Shakkamichi to'annoo xiyyaarichaa fudhachuuf yaaluun isaa xiyyaarichi dafee olka'umsa isaa akka gadi buusu taasisee ture, ta'us hojjettoonni biroo xiyyaaricha to'annoo isaanii jala galchuuf danda'aniiru. Xiyyaarichi namoota 174 fe'ee ture kun biyya Sa'ud Arabiyaatti dirqamaan lafa irra qubachuu kan danda'e yoo ta'u, aangotni dhimma kana irratti kaka'umsa isaa qorachaa jiru.

title: Gaza voters want jobs and security as Palestinian elections approach
english: Palestinians in Gaza are preparing for their first national legislative elections in two decades, scheduled for November 2026. Voters like Ahmad Mohsen are primarily focused on addressing the enclave's 80 percent unemployment rate, severe lack of security, and the urgent need for reconstruction following extensive wartime destruction. Residents hope that these elections will produce leaders who can stabilize the economy and restore basic services for the war-battered population.
amharic: በጋዛ የሚገኙ ፍልስጤማውያን ከሁለት አስርት ዓመታት በኋላ ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ በሚካሄደው ብሔራዊ የሕግ መወሰኛ ምክር ቤት ምርጫ ላይ ለመሳተፍ እየተዘጋጁ ነው። እንደ አህመድ ሞህሰን ያሉ መራጮች በዋናነት ትኩረት ያደረጉት በክልሉ ላይ በደረሰው የጦርነት ውድመት፣ በ80 በመቶ የሥራ አጥነት መጠን እና በደህንነት እጦት ላይ ነው። የጋዛ ነዋሪዎች ይህ ምርጫ የኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋትን የሚፈጥሩ እና በጦርነቱ የተጎዱትን አገልግሎቶች የሚያሻሽሉ መሪዎችን እንደሚያመጣ ተስፋ ያደርጋሉ።
oromo: Uummanni Gaza waggoota digdamii oliif booda yeroo jalqabaaf filannoo biyyoolessaa gaggeessuuf qophaa'aa jira. Jiraattonni akka Ahmad Mohsen, xiyyeeffannoo isaanii kan godhatan rakkoo hojidhabdummaa dhibbeentaa 80 ga'e, dhabamuu nageenyaa fi balaa waraanaan ga'e suphuufi. Namoonni naannichaa filannoo kanaan gaggeessitoota dinagdee tasgabbeessanii fi tajaajila bu'uuraa deebisanii dhaabuu danda'an ni arganna jedhanii abdatu.

title: Cornell frat house rape accuser 'under siege' online, says lawyer
english: A woman who alleges she was raped at a Cornell University fraternity in 2024 is currently facing intense harassment from online users attempting to reveal her identity. Her lawyer states that she was too intoxicated to consent during the incident and is now struggling under the pressure of social media scrutiny. Due to public outcry and concerns over the original investigation, the New York Attorney General has taken over the case, and state officials are working to address legal barriers regarding cases involving substance use.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ በ2024 በኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ የኮሌጅ ተማሪዎች ማህበር ቤት ውስጥ አስገድዶ መድፈር ተፈጽሞብኛል የምትል አንዲት ሴት፣ በማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ላይ ማንነቷን ለማጋለጥ በሚሞክሩ ሰዎች ከፍተኛ ወከባ እየደረሰባት መሆኑን ጠበቃዋ ተናግረዋል። በወቅቱ በነበረችበት ከፍተኛ ስካር ምክንያት ፈቃዷን መስጠት አትችልም ነበር ያሉት ጠበቃዋ፣ አሁን እየደረሰባት ባለው የኢንተርኔት ትንኮሳ ከፍተኛ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ ውስጥ እንዳለች ገልጸዋል። በጉዳዩ ላይ የቀረቡ ቅሬታዎችን ተከትሎ የኒውዮርክ ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ ምርመራውን እንዲረከቡ የተደረገ ሲሆን፣ በአልኮል ወይም በአደንዛዥ ዕፅ ምክንያት በሚከሰቱ መሰል ጥቃቶች ላይ ያለውን የህግ ክፍተት ለማስተካከል መንግስት እየሰራ ነው።
oromo: Dubartii bara 2024 yunivarsitii Cornell keessatti bakka jireenya barattootaatti gudeedameera jettee himattu tokko, miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti namoonni eenyummaa ishee saaxiluuf yaalan irraa miidhaa cimaa mudachaa jirti. Abukaatoo isheen akka jedhetti, dubartittiin yeroo sanatti machii cimaa keessa waan turteef walqunnamtii saalaaf eeyyama kennuuf hin dandeessu turte; ammas qeeqaa fi ari'atama miidiyaalee hawaasaa jala jirti. Hanqina qorannoo jalqabaa irratti dhihaate hordofee, abbaan alangaa olaanaa biyyaatti qorannoo kana kan fudhate yoo ta'u, mootummaan immoo namoonni alkoolii ykn qoricha sammuu namaa adoochutti fayyadamanii yakka gudeeddii raawwatan irratti seera cimaa baasuuf karoorfataa jira.

title: US and Australia suspend diplomatic operations in Brazil before election
english: The United States and Australia have temporarily suspended diplomatic and consular operations in Brazil due to unspecified security threats. Although Brazilian police conducted investigations into potential risks, they have not yet found concrete evidence or specific suspects. These closures occur just days before a significant national presidential election.
amharic: አሜሪካ እና አውስትራሊያ ባልታወቁ የደህንነት ስጋቶች ምክንያት በብራዚል የነበራቸውን የዲፕሎማሲ እና የቆንስላ አገልግሎት በጊዜያዊነት አቋርጠዋል። የብራዚል ፖሊስ ሊደርስ ስለሚችል አደጋ ምርመራ ቢያደርግም፣ እስካሁን ተጨባጭ ማስረጃ ወይም ተጠርጣሪ ማግኘት አልቻለም። ይህ እርምጃ የተወሰደው ወሳኝ የሆነው የብራዚል ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ ሊካሄድ ጥቂት ቀናት ሲቀሩት ነው።
oromo: Ameerikaa fi Awustiraaliyaan sodaa nageenyaa ifa hin taaneen walqabatee, Brazil keessatti tajaajila diippiloomaasii fi koonsilaa yeroof dhaabaniiru. Poolisiin Brazil balaa mudachuu danda'u irratti qorannoo geggeessus, hanga ammaatti ragaa qabatamaa ykn shakkamtoota adda baasuu hin dandeenye. Tarkaanfiin kun kan fudhatame filannoo pirezidaantummaa biyyattii murteessaa ta'eef guyyoota muraasa hafanitti.

title: Iran war live: Fighting intensifies in Yemen, hundreds killed or injured
english: Violent clashes have escalated significantly in Yemen, resulting in over 1,500 Houthi fighter casualties within a single day. Meanwhile, the Saudi-led coalition successfully intercepted three ballistic missiles directed at southern Saudi Arabia, though falling debris caused injuries. Additionally, the United States is pressing for stricter international sanctions on Iran while simultaneously targeting financial networks linked to Hamas.
amharic: በየመን እየተካሄደ ያለው ግጭት ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ የደረሰ ሲሆን በአንድ ቀን ውስጥ ብቻ ከ1,500 በላይ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ተገድለዋል ወይም ቆስለዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ በሳውዲ አረቢያ የሚመራው ጥምረት ወደ ደቡባዊ የሀገሪቱ ክፍል የተተኮሱ ሶስት ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን መትቶ መጣል የቻለ ቢሆንም፣ የወደቁት ፍርስራሾች በነዋሪዎች ላይ ጉዳት አድርሰዋል። በዚሁ ጊዜ፣ አሜሪካ በኢራን ላይ አለም አቀፍ ማዕቀቦች እንዲጠናከሩ እየጠየቀች እና ከሀማስ የገንዘብ ድጋፍ ጋር ግንኙነት ያላቸው አካላት ላይ አዲስ እርምጃዎችን እየወሰደች ነው።
oromo: Waraanni Yemen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiru daran jabaachuun, guyyaa tokko keessatti loltoonni Huti 1,500 ol ta'an ajjeefamuu ykn madaa'uu gabaafameera. Gama biraatiin, waraanni Saudii durfamu xiyyaawwan boombii sadii gara kibba Saudii Arabiyaatti dhukaafaman qilleensa keessatti kan dhaabe yoo ta'u, caccabni isaa namoota irra miidhaa geessiseera. Kana malees, Amerikaan Iran irratti tarkaanfiin diinagdee akka jabaatu kan gaafatte yoo ta'u, qaamolee maallaqa garee Hamas gargaaran irratti immoo qorannoo fi uggura haaraa irratti fuulleffatteetti.

title: Settlers kill 19-year-old Palestinian in West Bank, two injured, six detained
english: Israeli settlers shot and killed a 19-year-old Palestinian man near Ramallah in the occupied West Bank. During the incident, Israeli forces allegedly obstructed medical aid for the victim, and other Palestinians were injured by gunfire and tear gas. Additionally, six Palestinians were arrested by Israeli forces in separate raids across the region.
amharic: በተያዘው የዌስት ባንክ ክፍል ራማላ አቅራቢያ የእስራኤል ሰፈራተኞች የ19 ዓመት ፍልስጤማዊ ወጣት በጥይት ተኩሰው ገድለዋል። ግጭቱ በተከሰተበት ወቅት የእስራኤል ኃይሎች ለተጎጂው የህክምና እርዳታ እንዳይደረግ ከለከሉ፣ ሌሎች ፍልስጤማውያንም በጥይትና በለቅሶ ጋዝ ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። በተጨማሪም የእስራኤል ወታደሮች በተለያዩ አካባቢዎች ባደረጉት ዘመቻ ስድስት ፍልስጤማውያንን በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል።
oromo: Godina waldhiyaa (West Bank) magaalaa Ramalaatti, namoonni biyya Israa’el qubachiifaman dargaggeessa umuriin isaa 19 ta’e tokko dhukaasani ajjeesaniiru. Yeroo kana gargaarsi yaala fayyaa akka hin geenyeef waraanni Israa’el ugguruun, namoonni biroo immoo dhukaasaafi gaazii imimmaan fiduun miidhamaniiru. Kana malees, waraanni Israa’el naannolee garaagaraatti namoota Filisxeemii jaha to’annoo jala oolchaniiru.

title: Crude oil tanker hit by unknown projectile off Oman, UKMTO says
english: A crude oil tanker was struck by an unidentified object near the coast of Oman, according to maritime security authorities. Fortunately, all crew members on board are unharmed and there are no signs of environmental damage. Officials have issued a warning for other ships in the area to exercise extra vigilance while sailing.
amharic: የባህር ላይ ደህንነት ባለስልጣናት እንደገለጹት በኦማን የባህር ዳርቻ አቅራቢያ አንድ የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከብ በማይታወቅ ነገር ተመትቷል። እንደ እድል ሆኖ፣ በመርከቧ ላይ የነበሩት ሰራተኞች በሙሉ ደህና ናቸው እንዲሁም ምንም አይነት የአካባቢ ብክለት አልተከሰተም። ባለስልጣናቱ በአካባቢው ያሉ ሌሎች መርከቦች በጥንቃቄ እንዲጓዙ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Abbootiin taayitaa nageenya galaana akka ibsanitti, dooniin boba'aa fe'atte tokko qarqara galaana Omaanitti wanta hin beekamneen rukutamteetti. Gammachuu qabaachuu isaatiin, hojjettoonni doonii sanaa hundi miidhaan irra ga'e hin jiru akkasumas miidhaan naannawaatti geessifame tokko illee hin jiru. Abbootiin taayitaa sun dooniiwwan naannoo sana jiran hundi ofeeggannoo cimaa akka taasisan akeekkachiisaniiru.

title: Two Iranians charged over suspected plot to target Jews in Manchester
english: Two Iranian men have been charged in the UK for allegedly planning a terrorist attack against the Jewish community in Manchester. Authorities claim the suspects gathered materials to build an explosive device and scouted targets around the holy day of Yom Kippur. The UK government highlighted this case as part of a broader pattern of threats posed by the Iranian regime against Jewish people and critics abroad.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ ማንቸስተር በሚኖሩ የአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ ላይ የሽብር ጥቃት ለመፈጸም አቅደዋል የተባሉ ሁለት ኢራናውያን ክስ ቀረበባቸው። ተጠርጣሪዎቹ ፈንጂ ለመስራት የሚያስፈልጉ ቁሳቁሶችን በማሰባሰብና የዒላማ ቦታዎችን በመሰለል ላይ እንደነበሩ ተገልጿል። የብሪታንያ መንግስት ይህ ድርጊት በኢራን መንግስት የሚደገፍ እና በአይሁድ ማህበረሰብ ላይ ያነጣጠረ ተከታታይ ስጋት አካል መሆኑን ገልጿል።
oromo: Namootni lammii Iraan lama ta'an, magaalaa Maanchastar keessatti hawaasa Yihuudotaa irratti haleellaa shororkeessummaa raawwachuuf karoorfataniiru jedhamanii himataman. Shakkamtoonni kun meeshaalee dhuka'insaaf gargaaran walitti qabachaa akka turan fi bakkeewwan haleellaa raawwachuuf karoorfatan sakkata'aa akka turan poolisiin beeksiseera. Mootummaan Biriiteen, gochi kun mootummaan Iraan hawaasa Yihuudotaa fi namoota isaan morman irratti xiyyeeffatee raawwatu keessaa tokko ta'uu ibseera.

title: G7 to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel after Trump export ban threat
english: The G7 nations have collectively decided to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel to help lower global fuel costs and stabilize supply. This decision follows pressure from President Trump, who had warned about potential export bans to protect American consumers. As part of the agreement, member countries have pledged to avoid placing restrictions on energy exports to each other.
amharic: የሰባቱ ታላላቅ ኢኮኖሚዎች ቡድን (G7) የነዳጅ ዋጋ ንረትን ለመቆጣጠር እና አቅርቦትን ለማረጋጋት 100 ሚሊዮን በርሜል ድፍድፍ ነዳጅ እና ዲዝል ወደ ገበያ ለማውጣት ተስማምተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የመጣው ፕሬዚዳንት ትራምፕ በአሜሪካ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ላይ ያነሱትን ስጋት ተከትሎ ነው። ቡድኑ በአባል ሀገራት መካከል የነዳጅ ምርቶች ኤክስፖርት ላይ እገዳ እንዳያደርጉም ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Garee biyyoota gurguddoo torba (G7) jedhaman, gatii boba’aa dabalaa jiru tasgabbeessuuf fi dhiyeessii fooyyessuuf jechuun boba’aa fi diizilii miliyoona 100 gabaa irra oolchuuf murteessaniiru. Murteen kun kan dhufe erga pirezidaant Traamp dhiyeessii boba’aa Ameerikaa irratti yaaddoo ibsatanii booda dha. Biyyoonni miseensa ta’an kunis walii isaanii gidduutti daldala boba’aa irratti dhorkaa kamiyyuu akka hin goone waliigalaniiru.

title: US murderer Christa Pike unconscious and on ventilator after failed execution, lawyers say
english: Death row inmate Christa Pike is in critical condition and on a ventilator after a botched lethal injection attempt in Tennessee. Lawyers reported that prison officials struggled to administer the drugs, using multiple needles and causing Pike significant distress during the failed process. In response to the incident, the state governor has ordered an investigation and suspended all further executions for the remainder of the year.
amharic: በቴነሲ ግዛት በሞት ቀጣ ተፈርዶባት የነበረችው ክሪስታ ፓይክ በተደረገላት የሞት ፍርድ አፈጻጸም ሙከራ ሳይሳካ በመቅረቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በጽኑ ህክምና እና በአተነፋፈስ መርጃ መሳሪያ ስር ትገኛለች። የህግ ባለሙያዎቿ እንደገለጹት፣ አስፈጻሚ አካላት መርፌውን በአግባቡ ለመወጋት በመቸገራቸው እስረኛዋ ከፍተኛ ህመም እና ስቃይ እንደደረሰባት ተናግረዋል። ይህን ተከትሎ የቴነሲ ግዛት አስተዳዳሪ ምርመራ እንዲደረግ በማዘዝ በግዛቱ ውስጥ የሚከናወኑ የሞት ፍርድ አፈጻጸሞችን ለቀሪው አመት አግደዋል።
oromo: Magalaalchi Tennesseeitti namni ajjeechaaf itti murame Christa Pike, yeroo ajjeechaan sun itti raawwatamuu qabutti rakkoo mudateen booda amma hospitaala keessatti gargaarsa oksijiiniin jiratti. Abbootiin seeraa akka jedhanitti, namoonni ajjeechaa raawwachiisan sun iddoo gaarii maseelichaa argachuuf baay'ee dhiphatanii ture; kunis hidhamtuuttii sana irratti qaamaa fi sammuun miidhaa guddaa geessiseera. Haala kanaan walqabatee, bulchaan naannichaa qorannoon akka gaggeeffamu ajajeera; akkasumas hanga dhuma bara kanatti ajjeechaan biroo akka hin raawwatamne murteesseera.

title: Why Carney’s economic overhaul is clashing with Canada’s unions
english: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney is pushing for legislative changes to accelerate infrastructure projects and strengthen the economy amid trade pressures from the United States. However, his new bill, which would grant the government more authority to intervene in labor disputes, is facing intense backlash from major unions. Labor leaders argue these measures unfairly restrict their right to strike and are prepared to defy the proposed regulations.
amharic: የካናዳ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ማርክ ካርኒ ከአሜሪካ ጋር በተፈጠረ የንግድ ውጥረት ምክንያት የሀገሪቱን ኢኮኖሚ ለማጠናከር እና ትላልቅ ፕሮጀክቶችን ለማፋጠን አዳዲስ ህጎችን በማውጣት ላይ ናቸው። ይሁን እንጂ መንግስት በሰራተኞች አድማ ላይ ጣልቃ እንዲገባ ስልጣን የሚሰጠው ይህ ረቂቅ ህግ በሰራተኛ ማህበራት ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ተቃውሞ ገጥሞታል። የሰራተኛ ማህበራቱ ህጉ የአድማ መብታቸውን የሚጋፋ መሆኑን በመግለጽ፣ ህጉ ከጸደቀም ህጉን ለመቃወም መዘጋጀታቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Muummee Ministiraa Kaanaadaa Maark Kaarnii, dhiibbaa daldalaan Ameerikaarraa isaanirra ga'aa jiru dandamachuuf jecha, pirojektiiwwan gurguddoo saffisiisuufi dinagdee cimsuuf sirreeffama seeraa gochaa jiru. Ta'us, seeronni haaraan kun mootummaan hiriira mormii hojjettootaarratti akka gidduu galu aangoo waan kennaniif, gamtaawwan hojjettootaa gurguddoon mormaa jiru. Hojjettoonni kun mirga isaanii kan sarbu ta'uu eeruun, seeronni kun yoo ragga'anis falmachuuf qophii ta'uu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Croatia vs England: UEFA Nations League – Kane, Modric, teams, form
english: Croatia and England are set to face each other in a UEFA Nations League match this Saturday at the Rujevica Stadium in Croatia. Both teams have had identical starts in their group, each recording one win and one loss against Spain and the Czech Republic. The match highlights star players Harry Kane for England and the veteran Luka Modric, who continues to lead the Croatian midfield at age 41.
amharic: ክሮኤሽያ እና እንግሊዝ ቅዳሜ ዕለት በክሮኤሽያ ሩጄቪካ ስታዲየም በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ ይፋለማሉ። ሁለቱም ቡድኖች በምድባቸው እስካሁን አንድ ድል እና አንድ ሽንፈትን በማስተናገድ ተመሳሳይ ውጤት አስመዝግበዋል። ጨዋታው የእንግሊዙን አጥቂ ሃሪ ኬን እና በ41 ዓመቱ የክሮኤሽያን አማካይ ክፍል በብቃት እየመራ የሚገኘውን ሉካ ሞድሪች የሚያገናኝ ይሆናል።
oromo: Kiroo'eeshiyaa fi Ingilaandi Dilbata dhufu tapha UEFA Nations League taphachuuf Rujevica Stadium irratti wal arguuf qophaa'aa jiru. Gareewwan lameenuu garee isaanii keessatti injifannoo tokkoo fi injifatamuu tokko galmeessisuun sadarkaa wal fakkaatu irra jiru. Taphichi kabajaa fi hogganaa Ingilaandi Haarii Keeyn fi umrii waggaa 41 keessatti garee Kiroo'eeshiyaa hogganaa jiru Luka Modriich gidduutti akka taasifamu eegama.

title: Police bodycam shows Luigi Mangione arrest at Pennsylvania McDonald’s
english: Newly released body camera footage captures the moment police arrested Luigi Mangione at a McDonald’s in Altoona, Pennsylvania. The incident, which took place on December 9, 2024, shows officers conducting a search of the suspect. During the apprehension, law enforcement officials discovered a firearm inside his backpack.
amharic: በአልቱና ፔንሲልቬኒያ በሚገኝ ማክዶናልድስ ውስጥ ፖሊስ ሉዊጂ ማንግዮንን ሲይዝ የሚያሳይ የሰውነት ካሜራ ምስል ተለቋል። ታኅሣሥ 9 ቀን 2024 በተፈጸመው በዚህ ክስተት ወቅት ፖሊሶች ተጠርጣሪውን ሲፈትሹ ይታያሉ። በቁጥጥር ስር በዋሉበት ወቅትም በከረጢቱ ውስጥ ሽጉጥ መገኘቱ ተረጋግጧል።
oromo: Suur-sagaleen qaamaa irratti hidhatamu (bodycam) kan qabame, poolisoonni magaala Altoona, Pennsylvania keessatti argamu McDonald's tokko keessatti Luwii Maangiyoonii yommuu qaban kan agarsiisu gadi dhiifameera. Muddee 9, 2024 kan raawwatame gochi kun, poolisoonni shakkamaa kana yommuu sakatta'an kan agarsiisuudha. Yeroo qabamuu isaa kanattis, bagii isaa keessatti qawween argameera.

title: Israel could’ve ended Gaza war, freed captives sooner: Israel ex-negotiator
english: Former Israeli general Nitzan Alon stated that the war in Gaza could have ended and the captives returned much earlier if not for the government's prolonged approach. He described the Prime Minister's demand for total victory as misleading and noted that an earlier agreement would have saved many lives on both sides. Alon believes that the current strategic goals were achievable long before the actual October 2025 deal.
amharic: የቀድሞው የእስራኤል ጄኔራል ኒትዛን አሎን እንደተናገሩት፣ የመንግስት የዘገየ አካሄድ ባይኖር ኖሮ በጋዛ የሚካሄደው ጦርነት ቀደም ብሎ ሊያበቃ እና ታጋቾችም ቀደም ብለው ሊለቀቁ ይችሉ ነበር። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ «ሙሉ ድል» እፈልጋለሁ የሚሉት አባባል አሳሳች እንደሆነ የገለጹት ጄኔራሉ፣ ቀደም ብሎ ስምምነት ላይ ቢደረስ ኖሮ በሁለቱም በኩል በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ህይወቶችን ማዳን ይቻል እንደነበር ገልጸዋል። አሎን አሁን የተደረሰው ስምምነት ከረጅም ጊዜ በፊት ሊሳካ የሚችል እንደነበር ያምናሉ።
oromo: Ajajaan waraanaa Israa'el duraanii Nitzan Alon akka jedhanitti, mootummaan tarkaanfii ariifachiisaa fudhatatee osoo ta'e, waraanni Gaazaa kanaan dura xumuramee fi namoonni butamanis yeroo dheeraa dura bilisa ba'uu danda'u turan. Mummichi ministeerichaa injifannoo guutuu argachuuf waan jedhuun soba fi yeroo gubuu qofa akka ta'e dubbataniiru. Akka isaanii fi yaadannoo kanaatti, waliigaltee kanaan dura ta'ee ture osoo ta'e, jireenya namoota hedduu gama lamaanuu qusachuun danda'ama ture.

title: France held 1-1 by Italy in Zidane home debut after Olise stunner
english: France and Italy finished in a 1-1 draw during Zinedine Zidane's first home game as head coach at the Stade de France. Michael Olise gave the French side an early lead with a brilliant goal, but Alessandro Bastoni later equalized for the visitors. Despite the draw and a late red card for Dayot Upamecano, France remains at the top of their UEFA Nations League group.
amharic: ዚነዲን ዚዳን የፈረንሳይ ብሔራዊ ቡድን አሰልጣኝ ሆነው በስታድ ደ ፍራንስ ባደረጉት የመጀመሪያ የሜዳቸው ጨዋታ ፈረንሳይ እና ጣሊያን 1-1 በሆነ አቻ ውጤት ተለያይተዋል። ማይክል ኦሊሴ ግሩም ግብ በማስቆጠር ፈረንሳይን ቀዳሚ ቢያደርግም፣ አሌሳንድሮ ባስቶኒ ለጣሊያን አቻ ውጤቱን አስመዝግቧል። ዳዮት ኡፓሜካኖ በቀይ ካርድ ከሜዳ ቢሰናበትም፣ ፈረንሳይ በዩኤፋ ኔሽንስ ሊግ የምድቧን መሪነት ቀጥላለች።
oromo: Zinediin Zidaan leenjisaa garee biyyoolessa Faransaay ta'anii erga muudamanii booda, tapha isaanii isa jalqabaa Faransaay fi Xaaliyaan 1-1 ta'uun xumurameera. Maaykil Olisee goolii ajaa'ibsiisaa ta'een Faransaay dursee akka geggeessitu godheus, Alesandro Baastooniin Xaaliyaaniif taphicha qixxeesseera. Daayoot Upaamekaanoon kaardii diimaa argatee taphichaa baatus, Faransaay hiriira UEFA Nations League irratti garee ishee durfachuu itti fufteetti.

title: Riot police clash with students as education protests rage in France
english: Thousands of students across France are protesting against poor school conditions, including overcrowded classrooms and a shortage of teachers. These demonstrations have escalated into violent clashes with riot police, resulting in fires, arrests, and injuries to both protesters and officers. The government is concerned about the growing public disorder as the protests continue to spread from Paris to cities across the nation.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ የሚገኙ በሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ተማሪዎች በትምህርት ቤቶች ውስጥ ያለው መጨናነቅ እና የመምህራን እጥረት ባለበት ሁኔታ ላይ በመቃወም ሰላማዊ ሰልፍ እያደረጉ ነው። ሰልፉ ወደ ሁከት ተቀይሮ ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት የተፈጠረ ሲሆን በተማሪዎች እና በፖሊስ ላይ ጉዳት ደርሷል። የፈረንሳይ መንግስት አመጹ ከፓሪስ ወደ ሌሎች ከተሞች በመስፋፋቱ እና የህዝብ ሰላምን በመረበሹ ስጋት ላይ ይገኛል።
oromo: Barattoonni kumaan lakkaawaman Faransaay keessatti haala barnootaa gad aanaa fi hanqina barsiisotaa mormuun hiriira ba'aniiru. Hiriirri kun gara jeequmsaatti jijjiiramuun poolisoota wajjin walitti bu'iinsa uumee jira, kunis miidhaa namoota irratti geessiseera. Hiriirichi magaalaa Paarisii irraa gara magaaloota biroo biyyattii keessatti babal'achuun isaa mootummaa Faransaay yaaddoo keessa galchee jira.

title: Woman at centre of Cornell rape inquiry was 'failed' by officials, says New York governor
english: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has criticized the handling of a 2024 rape case at Cornell University, stating that authorities failed to support the victim throughout the process. The state Attorney General has been appointed to oversee a new investigation after the Governor lost confidence in local prosecutors. Additionally, the Governor aims to change laws to ensure that voluntarily using drugs or alcohol cannot be used as a defense for sexual assault.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ገዢ ካቲ ሆኩል በኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ የተፈጸመውን የአስገድዶ መድፈር ክስ ባለስልጣናት በአግባቡ ባለመያዛቸው ተጎጂዋ ተገቢውን ድጋፍ አላገኘችም ብለዋል። በአካባቢው አቃቤ ህግ ላይ እምነት በማጣታቸው፣ ጉዳዩን በድጋሚ እንዲመረምሩ የኒውዮርክ ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ እንዲረከቡ ተደርጓል። በተጨማሪም ገዢው ሆኩል፣ አንድ ሰው በአልኮል ወይም በአደንዛዥ እጾች ምክንያት አቅመ ቢስ ከሆነ ይህ ለወንጀል ፈጻሚዎች ሰበብ ሊሆን አይገባም በማለት ህጉን ለማሻሻል አቅደዋል።
oromo: Gantootni mootummaa Niiw Yoorkii, kan akka Kaathee Hookul, qorannoo gudeeddii yunivarsitii Koorneel irratti gaggeeffame sirrii miti jechuun komataniiru. Gochi kun miidhamtuu sanaaf eegumsa gochuu irraa kan hafe, mootummaan kan ishee dagate ta'uu isaa ibsaniiru. Giddu galeessi bulchiinsa naannoo tokko irraan kan ka'e, qorannoon kun amantii waan dhabeef, qorannoo haaraan abbaa alangaa biyyattii tiin akka geggeeffamuuf ajajameera. Kana malees, abbaan aangoo kun dhimmicha irratti seericha fooyyessuuf kan karoorsan yoo ta'u, namni tokko alkoolii ykn dawaa fayyadame jechuun qofa gudeeddii raawwachuun akka seeraan itti gaafatamuu qaban dubbataniiru.

title: Intensified Russian strikes are tearing Kyiv apart, warns mayor
english: Kyiv mayor Vitaliy Klitschko has warned that escalating Russian drone and missile attacks are severely damaging the city's critical infrastructure and threatening civilian survival. Recent strikes on a major bridge and internet data centers have caused significant transportation disruptions and communication outages throughout the capital. Officials believe these aggressive tactics are intended to incite fear and panic among the city's three million residents.
amharic: የኪየቭ ከንቲባ ቪታሊ ክሊችኮ እየተባባሰ የመጣው የሩሲያ የድሮን እና የሚሳኤል ጥቃት የከተማዋን መሠረተ ልማቶች በእጅጉ እየጎዳ እና የነዋሪዎችን ህይወት አደጋ ላይ እየጣለ መሆኑን አስጠንቅቀዋል። በዋና ድልድዮች እና በኢንተርኔት ማዕከላት ላይ የተሰነዘረው ጥቃት የትራንስፖርት እና የኮሙኒኬሽን መስተጓጎልን አስከትሏል። የሩሲያ ዋና ዓላማ በሶስት ሚሊዮን የከተማዋ ነዋሪዎች ላይ ፍርሃትን እና ሽብርን መፍጠር እንደሆነም ተገልጿል።
oromo: Kantiibaan magaalaa Kiyeev Vitaliy Klitschko, haleellaan rookeettii fi xiyyaara malee (drone) Raashiyaan gaggeessaa jirtu bu'uraalee misoomaa magaalamtii miidhuun jireenya lammiilee balaa irra buusa akka jiru akeekkachiisaniiru. Haleellaan daandii guddichaa fi iddoo tajaajila interneetii irratti raawwatame geejjibaa fi quunnamtii irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumeera. Kaayyoon Raashiyaa haleellaa kanaan uummata miliyoona sadii ta'e kanatti naasuu fi soda uumuu akka ta'e ibsameera.

title: Spanish PM Sánchez loses key housing crisis vote after eviction of woman, 87
english: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez suffered a major political setback after Congress rejected his proposed housing reform measures. These government decrees were introduced following nationwide public outrage over the eviction of an elderly woman from her apartment in Madrid. The defeat highlights the weakness of Sánchez's minority government, leading to increased speculation that he may be forced to call an early general election.
amharic: የስፔኑ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ፔድሮ ሳንቼዝ የቤቶች ችግርን ለመፍታት ያቀረቡት ሕግ በፓርላማ በመውደቁ ትልቅ የፖለቲካ ሽንፈት ገጥሟቸዋል። ይህ ሕግ በአንድ አዛውንት ሴት መኖሪያ ቤት መፈናቀል ምክንያት በመላ ሀገሪቱ በተቀሰቀሰው የተቃውሞ ሰልፍ ተከትሎ የቀረበ ነበር። የሕጉ መውደቅ የጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ መንግሥት ያለውን ደካማ ድጋፍ የሚያሳይ ሲሆን፣ ይህም ቀደም ብሎ ምርጫ እንዲካሄድ ጫና እያሳደረ ይገኛል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa Ispeen Pedro Saancheez seerota rakkoo mana jireenyaa furuuf dhiyeessan mana maree biyyattii keessatti waan hin fudhatamneef injifannoo siyaasaa guddaa isa mudateera. Seerri kun kan dhiyaate dubartii dulloomtuu tokko mana ishee irraa buqqifamuun biyyattii keessatti mormii guddaa erga kaasee booda ture. Kufatiin seerota kanaa mootummaan Saancheez deggarsa gahaa akka hin qabne kan mirkaneessu yoo ta'u, kunis filannoon hatattamaa akka gaggeeffamu dhiibbaa uumaa jira.

title: Israeli barrier cuts off water to West Bank Palestinians before elections
english: Israeli forces have imposed a severe siege on the Bedouin community of Ras al-Ahmar in the West Bank by constructing a new military barrier. This blockade has cut off essential supplies like water, animal feed, and medical care, putting both residents and their 15,000 livestock at critical risk. Families are now forced to transport supplies secretly at night to avoid soldiers and settlers who are reportedly trying to displace them from their land.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በዌስት ባንክ ራስ አል-አህማር ለሚኖሩ የቤዱዊን ማህበረሰብ አዲስ መከላከያ በመገንባት ከፍተኛ እገዳ ጥለዋል። ይህ እገዳ ውሃን፣ የእንስሳት መኖን እና የህክምና አገልግሎቶችን ጨምሮ መሰረታዊ አቅርቦቶችን በማቋረጡ ነዋሪዎቹን እና ያላቸውን 15 ሺህ ከብቶች ለአደጋ ዳርጓል። ነዋሪዎቹ ከወታደሮች እና ከሰፋሪዎች ለመደበቅ ሲሉ ውሃ እና ሌሎች አስፈላጊ ቁሳቁሶችን በምሽት በአህያ ለማጓጓዝ ተገደዋል።
oromo: Humnootiin Israa'el naannoo Qarxii dhihaa kan ta'e Ras al-Ahmar keessatti dhoorkaa waraanaa haaraa ijaaruun gandoota sana iratti harka keessa galchanii jiru. Dhoorkaan kun bishaan, nyaata beeyiladaa fi tajaajila fayyaa dabalatee meeshaalee barbaachisoo ta'an akka hin geenye waan ta'eef, jireenya namootaa fi beeyilada isaanii kuma 15 ol ta'an balaadhaaf saaxilee jira. Jiraattonni kunis waraanaa fi qubattoota irraa dhokachuuf jedhanii bishaan fi meeshaalee biroo halkan halkan gaangeedhaan fe'uuf dirqamanii jiru.

title: Israel’s Supreme Court overturns election panel ban on Arab parties
english: Israel's Supreme Court has overturned a decision by the Central Elections Committee to ban major Arab political parties from the upcoming national election. The court ruled that the disqualifications lacked sufficient legal justification, ensuring that Palestinian citizens of Israel remain represented in the vote. Additionally, Jewish lawmaker Ofer Cassif was reinstated to the ballot, though Balad party leader Sami Abu Shehadeh withdrew his candidacy following pressure from the court.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የማዕከላዊ ምርጫ ኮሚቴ ዋነኛ የአረብ የፖለቲካ ፓርቲዎችን ከምርጫ ለማግለል የወሰነውን ውሳኔ ሽሯል። ፍርድ ቤቱ የማግለል ውሳኔው በቂ ህጋዊ ምክንያት እንደሌለው በማመን የአረብ ተወላጆች በምርጫው እንዲሳተፉ ወስኗል። እንዲሁም የአይሁድ ተወላጁ የፓርላማ አባል ኦፈር ካሲፍ በምርጫው እንዲወዳደሩ ሲፈቀድላቸው የባላድ ፓርቲ መሪ ሳሚ አቡ ሸሃዴ ግን ከጫና የተነሳ ከምርጫው እራሳቸውን አግልለዋል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Israa'el koreen filannoo biyyattii paartilee siyaasaa Arabaa filannoo dhufu irraa dhowwuu isaa shuruunsaa fi fashaleesseera. Mana murtiichaa akka jedhetti, dhoowwii paartilee kanaa irra kaa'ame gahaa miti jedhee waan murteesseef, lammiileen Israa'el kan ta'an Araboonni filannoo irratti hirmaachuu danda'u. Kana malees, miseensi paarlamaa Yihudii Ofer Kaasiif filannicha irratti akka hirmaatu kan heyyamame yoo ta'u, hogganaan paartii Baalaad Saamii Abuu Shehaade garuu dhiibbaa isa irratti godhame hordofee filannoo keessaa of baaseera.

title: ‘I want the truth’: NY governor appoints prosecutor in Cornell rape case
english: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has appointed State Attorney General Letitia James as a special prosecutor to re-examine a 2024 gang rape case at Cornell University. The governor took this action after criticizing local authorities for failing to properly interview the victim or thoroughly investigate the initial allegations. This move transfers control of the criminal case from the local district attorney to the state level to ensure a transparent and comprehensive search for the truth.
amharic: የኒውዮርክ ገዢ ካቲ ሆኩል በኮርኔል ዩኒቨርሲቲ በ2024 ተፈጽሟል በተባለ የቡድን አስገድዶ መድፈር ወንጀል ላይ ዳግም ምርመራ እንዲደረግ የአካባቢውን አቃቤ ህግ በመተካት የክልሉን ጠቅላይ አቃቤ ህግ ሌቲሻ ጄምስን ልዩ አቃቤ ህግ አድርገው ሾመዋል። ገዢዋ ይህን የወሰኑት የአካባቢው ባለስልጣናት የወንጀሉን ሰለባ በአግባቡ ባለመጠየቃቸው እና ምርመራውን በአግባቡ ባለማከናወናቸው ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ ጉዳዩን ከአካባቢው አቃቤ ህግ ወደ ክልሉ በማዛወር እውነተኛውን መረጃ ለማግኘት እና ፍትህ ለመስጠት ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Gantootni biyya Niiw Yoork Kaathii Hookul qorannoo himata gudeeddii garee Yunivarsitii Koorneel irratti bara 2024 dhiyaateef, abbaa alangaa olaantuu biyyattii Leetishaa Jeemsi abbaa alangaa addaa ta'anii akka qoratan muudaniiru. Hookul tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatan, qondaaltoonni naannichaa miidhamtuu sana mariisisuu fi qorannoo gahaa gaggeessuu dhabuun isaanii erga isaan komatanii boodadha. Tarkaanfiin kun dhimmi kun harka abbaa alangaa naannichaatii ba'ee harka mootummaa biyyattiin akka qoratamuufi dhugaan isaa akka ifa ba'uuf taasifame.

title: Jerusalem Daily: Who gets to run in Israel’s elections?
english: The Israeli Supreme Court has issued a ruling that is raising concerns among Palestinians in Israel regarding their representation in upcoming elections. Many are questioning whether they will be granted a fair and equal opportunity to participate in the democratic process. This judicial decision has sparked a significant debate about political inclusion and rights for the Palestinian minority within the state.
amharic: የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ፍርድ ቤት የሰጠው ብያኔ በእስራኤል የሚኖሩ ፍልስጤማውያን በመጪው ምርጫ ተሳትፎአቸው ላይ ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ፍልስጤማውያኑ በዴሞክራሲያዊ ሂደት ውስጥ ፍትሃዊ እና እኩል የሆነ የመወዳደር እድል ይኖራቸው እንደሆነ እየጠየቁ ይገኛሉ። ይህ የፍርድ ቤት ውሳኔ በአገሪቱ ውስጥ ባሉ ፍልስጤማውያን አናሳ ብሄረሰቦች የፖለቲካ ተሳትፎ እና መብቶች ዙሪያ ትልቅ ክርክር አስነስቷል።
oromo: Mana murtii olaanaa Israa'el murtee darbe irratti hundaa'uun, lammiileen Phalastinaa Israa'el keessa jiraatan filannoo dhufu irratti hirmaannaa qabaachuu danda'an ilaalchisee yaaddoo qabu. Namoonni kunneen adeemsa dimokiraasii kana keessatti carraa qixa ta'e argachuu akka danda'an shakkuufi gaaffii kaasu jiru. Murteen kun murni xiqqeenyaan kun mirga siyaasaa fi hirmaannaa isaanii irratti jijjiirama akkamii akka fidu irratti mormii guddaa uumee jira.

title: How the Banco Master scandal injected chaos into Brazil’s presidential race
english: Brazil's presidential election is facing significant uncertainty due to the massive Banco Master fraud scandal. The scheme involved a bank offering unsustainable high-yield returns and hiding assets, which has negatively impacted both leading candidates, Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and Flavio Bolsonaro. Consequently, voters are showing widespread disillusionment and low enthusiasm, as both politicians struggle with high rejection rates ahead of the upcoming vote.
amharic: የብራዚል የፕሬዚዳንታዊ ምርጫ በባንኮ ማስተር የገንዘብ ማጭበርበር ቅሌት ሳቢያ ከፍተኛ ውዝግብ ውስጥ ገብቷል። ይህ ባንክ ዘላቂነት የሌለው ከፍተኛ ትርፍ ቃል በመግባት እና ንብረቶቹን በድብቅ በማዘዋወር የሀገሪቱን የፖለቲካ መድረክ አወኩት። በሁለቱ ዋና ተፎካካሪዎች ላይ የደረሰው የቅሌቱ ተጽዕኖ በምርጫው ላይ የህዝብ ተስፋ መቁረጥን አስከትሎ ከፍተኛ መቃወሚያ እንዲገጥማቸው አድርጓል።
oromo: Filannoon pirezidaantii biyya Braazil malaammaltummaa baankii Maastar jedhamuun walqabatee rakkoo cimaa keessa galee jira. Baankiin kun bu'aa guddaa waadaa galuun qabeenya seeraan alaa gadi lakkisuun isaa, dorgomtoota pirezidaantii lamaan irrattuu dhiibbaa gaarii hin taane uumee jira. Kana irraa kan ka'e, uummanni filannoo kana irratti abdii kutachuu fi diddaa guddaa agarsiisaa jiru.

title: Houthis say Saudi forces launched 94 strikes in Yemen in 24 hours
english: Houthi officials reported that Saudi military forces conducted 94 airstrikes within their territories over the last 24 hours. The group claims these attacks are part of an ongoing escalation that has seen over 1,350 strikes since the recent resumption of civil war hostilities. These events mark a significant increase in the intense conflict between the Houthi movement and the Saudi-supported government.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የሳውዲ አረቢያ ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች ባለፉት 24 ሰዓታት ውስጥ እነሱ በሚቆጣጠሩት አካባቢዎች ላይ 94 የአየር ጥቃቶችን መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ቡድኑ እንደገለጸው፣ የእርስ በርስ ጦርነቱ እንደገና ከተቀሰቀሰ ወዲህ በድምሩ ከ1,350 በላይ ጥቃቶች ተፈጽመዋል። ይህ ሁኔታ በሁቲዎች እና በሳውዲ በሚደገፈው የየመን መንግስት መካከል ያለው ግጭት እያደገ መምጣቱን ያሳያል።
oromo: Humni Hootii akka ibsetti, waraanni Saudi Arabiyaa sa'aatii 24 darban keessatti naannoo isaan to'atan irratti haleellaa xiyyaaraa 94 gaggeesseera. Gareen kun akka jedhutti, lola kana keessatti haleellaa waliigalaa 1,350 ol ta'antu raawwatame. Kunis walitti bu'iinsa garee Hootii fi mootummaa Saudi irraa deggaramaa jiru gidduutti jiru hammaachuu isaa kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Saudi-led coalition says it destroyed three missiles launched by Houthis
english: The Saudi-led military coalition announced that they successfully intercepted and neutralized three ballistic missiles. These projectiles were fired by Houthi rebels from Yemen and were aimed at the Saudi Arabian city of Khamis Mushait. No further details regarding damages or injuries were reported following the incident.
amharic: በሳዑዲ የሚመራው ጥምረት በየመን የሁቲ አማጽያን ተተኩሰው የነበሩ ሶስት ባሊስቲክ ሚሳኤሎችን መትቶ መጣሉን አስታውቋል። ሚሳኤሎቹ ያነጣጠሩት ወደ ሳዑዲ አረቢያዋ ከተማ ካሚስ ሙሻይት ነበር። እስካሁን በደረሰው ጥቃት ስለተፈጠረ ጉዳት ወይም ጉዳት የደረሰበት ሰው ስለመኖሩ የተገለጸ ነገር የለም።
oromo: Mootummaan Saudii durfamu waraana Yemen keessatti houthiiwwan irratti gaggeessaa jiru, xiyyaara kombuu (missile) sadii houthiiwwan gara magaalaa Khamis Mushait jedhamtutti furgugisanii turan fashaleesseera. Xiyyaaronni kunniin kallattiin gara biyya Saudi Arabiyaatti kan qiyyaafatamanii turan ta'us, humnoonni ittisaa xiyyaara qilleensa irraa gadi qaban kana balleessaniiru. Namoota irratti miidhaan ga'e ykn mancaatiin qabeenyaa ilaalchisee odeeffannoon dabalataa hin kennamne.

title: Lapid says young Israelis told him 'even babies' in Gaza should be killed
english: Former Israeli Prime Minister Yair Lapid recently shared that he met with young Israelis who expressed extreme views, claiming that no one in Gaza is innocent. During the conversation, these individuals argued that even infants should be killed because they would allegedly grow up to be terrorists. Lapid described this encounter as both angry and distressing while highlighting the intensity of the rhetoric he heard.
amharic: የቀድሞው የእስራኤል ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ያኢር ላፒድ ከወጣት እስራኤላውያን ጋር ባደረጉት ውይይት፣ በጋዛ ንጹሐን ሰዎች እንደሌሉ የሚገልጽ እጅግ አደገኛ አስተያየት እንደሰሙ ተናግረዋል። እነዚህ ወጣቶች ሕፃናት ሳይቀሩ ለወደፊቱ አሸባሪዎች ስለሚሆኑ መገደል አለባቸው ብለው ማመናቸውን ላፒድ ገልጸዋል። የቀድሞው ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ይህንን ስብሰባ እጅግ አሳዛኝ እና የሚያበሳጭ እንደሆነ ገልጸውታል፡፡
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa duraanii Israa'el Ya'iir Laapid dargaggoota Israa'el tokko tokkoo wajjin yeroo mari'atan, Gaaza keessatti namni qulqulluun akka hin jirre ibsamuu isaanii dubbataniiru. Dargaggoonni kunneen daa'immanii illee gara fuulduraatti shororkeessitoota waan ta'aniif ajjeefamuu qabu jechuun yaada cimaa kennaniiru. Laapid mariin kun baay'ee kan nama gaddisiisuufi aarsu ta'uu isaa ibseera.

title: Iraq given US exemption for Iranian flights to and from holy city
english: The United States has approved a sanctions waiver allowing Iranian airlines to resume flights to the Iraqi holy city of Najaf. Under this new agreement, most Iranian carriers can operate up to 40 daily flights, though Mahan Air remains excluded from the exemption. This decision follows a recent suspension of flights that had caused significant travel disruptions for pilgrims visiting the city.
amharic: አሜሪካ የኢራን አየር መንገዶች ወደ ኢራቅ የተቀደሰችው ናጃፍ ከተማ በረራ እንዲያደርጉ ማዕቀቡን በከፊል አነሳች። በተደረሰው ስምምነት መሰረት፣ ከማሃን ኤር በስተቀር ሌሎች የኢራን አየር መንገዶች በቀን እስከ 40 በረራዎችን ማከናወን ይችላሉ። ይህ ውሳኔ የተላለፈው በቅርቡ በረራዎች ተቋርጠው የነበረውን የጉዞ መስተጓጎል ለመፍታት ነው።
oromo: Amerikaa dirree xiyyaaraa magaalatti Najaf kan Iiraaq keessatti argamutti, yaa'insa xiyyaaraa Iiraan irratti kaawwame ture irraa ittisa ykn hayyama addaa kenniteetti. Walii galtee kana irratti hundaa'uun, xiyyaaronni Iiraan kan Mahan Air hin dabalanne, guyyaatti balali 40 gochuu ni danda'u. Murtoon kun kan darbe, balaliin xiyyaaraa erga dhaabbatee booda namoota iddoo kana daawwatan irratti rakkoo uumame furuufi.

title: Turkey's defence ministry condemns Houthi drone attack on Saudi Arabia
english: The Turkish Ministry of Defense has officially denounced a drone strike carried out by Houthi rebels against Saudi Arabia. Officials emphasized that these ongoing attacks jeopardize both regional security and the safety of global maritime trade routes. Turkey is urging an immediate halt to these aggressive actions to help restore stability in the area.
amharic: የቱርክ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር ሁቲዎች በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ የፈጸሙትን የድሮን ጥቃት በይፋ አውግዟል። ሚኒስቴሩ እነዚህ ተደጋጋሚ ጥቃቶች ለቀጠናው ደህንነት እና ለዓለም አቀፍ የባህር ንግድ እንቅስቃሴ ትልቅ ስጋት መሆናቸውን ገልጿል። ቱርክ ቀጠናዊ መረጋጋትን ለመጠበቅ ሲባል ሁቲዎች እነዚህን ድርጊቶች እንዲያቆሙ ጠይቃለች።
oromo: Ministeerri Raayyaa Ittisa Biyyaa Turkii haleellaa xiyyaara nama hin qabatin (drone) gareen Huutii Saudii Arabiyaa irratti raawwate balaaleffateera. Hojiin garee kanaa nageenya naannichaa fi imala daldala galaana addunyaa irratti balaa akka qabu ibsameera. Turkii tasgabbii naannichaa kabachiisuuf jecha gareen kun gochaa isaa dhaabuu akka qabu akeekkachiisteetti.

title: School protests send shivers down French government's spine
english: French teenagers are currently organizing widespread protests that have forced hundreds of schools to close across the country. The government is deeply concerned because student-led demonstrations in France have a history of escalating into broader social unrest and violence. With ongoing property damage and injuries reported among both staff and law enforcement, officials are struggling to manage a movement that lacks a clear leadership structure.

title: 'Ashamed': Cornell students gather to voice anger over alleged gang rape
english: Cornell University students recently gathered to express their outrage and shame regarding the school's handling of a 2024 alleged gang rape case. A lawsuit filed by the survivor claims the university failed to protect her or take sufficient action against the accused fraternity members. In response to the growing tension and student protests, New York Governor Kathy Hochul has appointed the state attorney general to serve as a special prosecutor for the investigation.

oromo: Barattoonni Yunivarsitii Cornell bara 2024 gochi suukanneessaan gareen gudeedduu raawwatame jedhamee amanamu ilaalchisee rakkoo bulchiinsa yunivarsitichaa mormuun walgahii gaggeessaniiru. Namni miidhaan irra gahe kun, yunivarsitichi balaa kana ittisuufis ta'e miidhaa kana qaqqabsiisaniif tarkaanfii gahaa fudhachuu akka hin dandeenye himatteetti. Rakkoo fi mormii barattootaa kana hordofee, bulchaan kutaa New York Kathy Hochul dhimma kana akka qoratuuf abbaan alangaa addaa akka ramadamu murteessaniiru.

title: Man City lodge appeal after guilty finding in financial breach scandal
english: Manchester City has officially appealed a ruling that found the club guilty of systematically violating Premier League financial regulations over a nine-year period. The club maintains its innocence, arguing that the initial decision was based on significant legal and factual errors. An independent appeal board will now review the case to determine whether to uphold, modify, or overturn the original findings.

title: Trump vs Europe as US presses for release of emergency diesel stocks
english: The Trump administration is pressuring European leaders to release 120 million barrels from their emergency diesel reserves to combat record-high fuel prices in the United States. These price spikes are largely driven by global conflicts, including the war in Ukraine and the US conflict with Iran, which have disrupted international energy supplies. While the US is considering export restrictions to address domestic political pressure before the midterms, EU officials are currently evaluating how to respond to this request through a coordinated approach.

title: Wolf encounter: A photographer on what humans have lost
english: Norwegian wildlife photographer Lasse Huldt Pedersen shared an intense, rare experience of coming face-to-face with a wild wolf in the forest. During this brief encounter, the animal maintained steady eye contact, forcing the photographer to let go of modern distractions and exist entirely in the moment. Pedersen believes that such primal interactions serve as a powerful reminder of what humans lose when they disconnect from the natural world.

title: Protests shutter hundreds of French schools as violence flares
english: Hundreds of high schools across France have closed following widespread student protests over overcrowded classrooms and staff shortages. The demonstrations have escalated into violent clashes, resulting in numerous injuries, property damage, and the detention of around 2,000 individuals. Government officials have expressed deep concern for student safety and are urging parents to keep their children away from the volatile protests.

title: Ebola death toll surpasses 4,000 as DR Congo struggles to suppress outbreak
english: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached a record-breaking death toll of over 4,000, with more than 8,300 confirmed cases. Efforts to control the virus are severely hampered by regional conflict, poor infrastructure, and significant public distrust of health authorities. The situation recently worsened after a transit center was destroyed, causing thousands to flee and disrupting essential treatment services.

title: US pressures Europe to release diesel reserves as Trump threatens export ban
english: President Trump is considering banning US diesel exports to lower domestic prices ahead of the upcoming midterm elections. In response, US officials are urging European nations to tap into their own fuel reserves to offset the potential supply shortage. This move could significantly impact the UK, which relies heavily on American diesel imports as prices reach record highs globally due to ongoing conflict in Iran.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ በመካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫው ዋዜማ የአሜሪካን የነዳጅ ዋጋ ለመቀነስ ሲሉ የናፍጣ ላክን ለመገደብ እያሰቡ ነው። ለዚህም ምላሽ የአሜሪካ ባለስልጣናት የአውሮፓ ሀገራት ሊፈጠር የሚችለውን የነዳጅ እጥረት ለመቅረፍ የራሳቸውን ክምችት እንዲጠቀሙ ግፊት እያደረጉ ነው። ይህ ውሳኔ በኢራን ጦርነት ምክንያት የናፍጣ ዋጋ በከፍተኛ ደረጃ በተወደደበት ወቅት ከአሜሪካ ነዳጅ ለሚያስገቡ እንደ ብሪታንያ ላሉ ሀገራት ከፍተኛ ተጽዕኖ ሊኖረው ይችላል።
